label: S360 - Hub & Node Mgmt
info:
Gestión de Hubs (HUB_ONLINE) y Nodos (CRUD + envío de config vía MQTT).

Tópicos MQTT:
- Escucha: seguimiento360/hub/status
- Publica: seguimiento360/tenant/{tid}/site/{sid}/hub/{mac}/node_cfg

Endpoints REST:
- GET    /api/nodes?hub_id=X
- POST   /api/nodes
- PUT    /api/nodes/:id
- DELETE /api/nodes/:id

label: S360 - Portal API & Eventos
info:
Persistencia de eventos en PostgreSQL y APIs de consulta para el portal web multiusuario.

Endpoints:
- GET /api/events (filtros: site_id, node_mac, event_type, from, to, limit, offset)
- GET /api/overview (sitios + hubs + nodos del tenant)

SELECT overview
query:
SELECT COALESCE(s.id, 0) AS site_id,
       COALESCE(s.name, 'Sin sitio asignado') AS site_name,
       h.id AS hub_id, h.name AS hub_name, h.serial_number AS hub_mac,
       h.status AS hub_status, h.last_seen AS hub_last_seen,
       COALESCE(ast.state, 'disarmed') AS alarm_state,
       n.id AS node_id, n.mac_address AS node_mac, n.name AS node_name,
       n.location, n.room, n.distance_threshold, n.status AS node_status
FROM hubs h
LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.id = h.site_id AND s.tenant_id = h.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN alarm_state ast ON ast.hub_id = h.id
LEFT JOIN nodes n ON n.hub_id = h.id
WHERE h.tenant_id = $1
ORDER BY site_name, hub_name, node_name;

INSERT token push
query:
INSERT INTO user_fcm_tokens (user_id, tenant_id, token, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, NOW())
ON CONFLICT ((token->>'endpoint')) DO UPDATE
SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id,
    tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id,
    token = EXCLUDED.token,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, user_id, tenant_id, updated_at;
